headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.shapeCeiling_le_iff

headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.positiveTraceShapeBlock_eq_ceiling
headlines.statement:
∀ (xs ys : List ℕ),
  Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.positiveTraceBranch xs ys = Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.TraceInputBranch.reference →
    Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.positiveTraceShapeBlock xs ys =
      Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.shapeCeiling (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.positiveTraceOuterBlock xs ys)
        (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.inverseSupportAllowance (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.filteredMargin xs)
          (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.filteredMargin ys) (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.positiveTraceCutoff xs ys))

headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.positiveTraceShapeBlock_le_iff
headlines.statement:
∀ (xs ys : List ℕ),
  Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.positiveTraceBranch xs ys = Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.TraceInputBranch.reference →
    ∀ (k : ℕ),
      Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.positiveTraceShapeBlock xs ys ≤ k ↔
        Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.positiveTraceOuterBlock xs ys ≤
          k *
            Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.inverseSupportAllowance (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.filteredMargin xs)
              (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.filteredMargin ys) (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.positiveTraceCutoff xs ys)

headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.positiveTraceShape_budget
headlines.statement:
∀ (xs ys : List ℕ),
  Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.positiveTraceBranch xs ys = Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.TraceInputBranch.reference →
    ∀
      (start :
        Math115.PhysicalDefectTrace.DefectVertices (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.filteredMargin xs)
          (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.filteredMargin ys) (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.positiveTraceCutoff xs ys) 7)
      (t : ℕ),
      (1 - Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.positiveTraceCorrectionSuccess xs ys) ^
            Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.positiveTraceShapeAttempts xs ys t +
          ↑(Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.positiveTraceShapeAttempts xs ys t) *
            (Math115.CompletionRetryBudget.dyadic (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.positiveTraceShapePrecision xs ys t) +
              Math115.CompletionRetryBudget.dyadic (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.positiveTraceShapePrecision xs ys t)) ≤
        Math115.CompletionRetryBudget.dyadic t

headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.positiveTraceShapeScheduled_accuracy

  (htotal : ∑ i, Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.listMargin xs i = ∑ j, Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.listMargin ys j)
  (hb : Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.positiveTraceBranch xs ys = Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.TraceInputBranch.reference)
  (start :
    Math115.PhysicalDefectTrace.DefectVertices (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.filteredMargin xs)
      (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.filteredMargin ys) (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.positiveTraceCutoff xs ys) 7)
  (fallback :
    OAI.ContingencyTables.Table (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.filteredMargin xs)
      (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.filteredMargin ys))
  (t : ℕ),
  OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.variation
      (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.positiveTraceShapeScheduledLaw xs ys hb start fallback t)
      OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.uniformLaw ≤
    Math115.CompletionRetryBudget.dyadic t
